description: Camp Event Notifications compatibility test. P1 — tests event hooks, Osiris, and headless-safe IMGUI queries.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do if u == '1b8d381f-6210-4473-85be-600457267a87' then return true end end return false end)(), 'Camp Event Notifications (KvCampEvents) present in load order')
assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')

assert((function() local size=Ext.IMGUI.GetViewportSize(); return type(size) == 'table' and type(size[1]) == 'number' and size[1] > 0 and type(size[2]) == 'number' and size[2] > 0 end)(), 'IMGUI viewport query executes')
notes: Requires MCM; the runner injects it automatically. Tests IMGUI notification rendering without creating a headless window.
